reviewSamples.author: Amanda Raprager
reviewSamples.text: Nick and his team did a beautiful job on my home. They were kind, professional, and extremely detailed oriented. They made sure to talk to me about all of the small pieces and fine details. They got finished quickly, and it's beautiful. I am very happy, and I would highly recommend them.

reviewSamples.author: Natalie O'Malley
reviewSamples.text: I had a GREAT experience working with Nick and his team. They were very professional and from the first moment I met with him, I could tell he really knew his stuff. He made the process very easy for me and got it done rapidly.

reviewSamples.author: Michael Drovie
reviewSamples.text: Nick was very nice, and very knowledgeable about painting. I had some special requests and he gladly took care of them. The work his company did was phenomenal.
